## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.1.0

The EXE now includes a Terminal interface. Open it from the GUI or start the EXE with `--terminal`. The standalone PowerShell collector has been removed from the current source.

Workbook Setup can save the workbook to another location. Recorded rows can be edited by double-clicking them, and Manual Drive Entry now has a searchable, alphabetized drive type list and its own Copy Last Drive button. The banner's info button opens Version Information; the duplicate Details controls and the version in the main window title are gone.

This release also replaces the one-time v4.0.0 publishing workflow with a versioned signing workflow. The Windows preview build remains available for pull requests.
